items.text: mera cheque book mangwana hai
kab milega
address kya hai
theek hai
haan ji
kal tak
abhi call kar sakta hu
address batata hu

items.context: Kya aapne cheque book online order kiya hai?
items.text: online order kar diya
mera naam rahul sharma hai aur mujhe new cheque book chahiye
kya aap pata kar sakte ho ki mera cheque book dispatch hua hai ya nahi
mera account delhi branch me hai aur mai cheque book ka status janna chahta hu
main 2 hafto se wait kar raha hu mera cheque book deliver nahi hua
kya aap mujhe bata sakte ho mera cheque book kab tak aayega
mera registered address sector 15 gurgaon me hai to delivery me der kyun ho rahi hai
please mujhe urgent cheque book chahiye mera naam amit verma hai

items.context: Aapka naam aur account number please?
items.text: haan mera naam akash chaudhary hai aur mujhe ek naya cheque book banana hai
mera address lucknow ka hai aur main cheque book ke delivery date puch raha hu

items.context: Kya aapne cheque book ke liye online request kiya tha?
items.text: yes main ne online request kiya tha par abhi tak status update nahi hua

items.context: Aapke branch location kaunse shehar me hai?
items.text: mera pura naam sunil kumar hai aur branch patna hai kya wo affect hota hai delivery me

items.context: Aap delivery ke expected time frame ke baare me pooch rahe hain?
items.text: kab tak mai expect kar sakta hu delivery main delay bohot ho raha hai
mera naam priyanka agarwal hai aur main lucknow branch ki customer hu mujhe apna naya cheque book mangwana hai
maine february me cheque book ke liye request ki thi par mujhe abhi tak koi update nahi mila hai mujhe status batayein
main apne registered address sector 5 noida me rehti hu to kya mera cheque book timely deliver hoga please batayein

items.context: Kab aapne cheque book ke liye request kiya tha?
items.text: main aapki madad karne ke liye yaha hu aap bata sakte hain ki aapke cheque book ka request kab kiya tha

items.context: Kya aap apna account number provide kar sakte hain?
items.text: kya aapke paas apna account number hai jisse main aapki details verify kar saku aur aapko update de saku

items.context: Aapka registered address kya hai? Please confirm.
items.text: main samajh sakta hu ki aapko urgent cheque book chahiye aap apna registered address confirm kar dijiye please

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: cheque_book - requests a new cheque book or asks about its delivery
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
